We need DBE for C14H2O4. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). No N. So DBE = 14 - 2/2 + 1 = 14 -1 +1 =14. Wait check: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1. For C14H2: 14 - 1 + 1 =14. O ignored. So DBE =14. Provide integer.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
